What It Checks: Pending PO count vs truck count (allowed = 0.5x trucks); secondary check on POs older than 90 days
Green: Pending <=25% of allowed; aging <=5% of allowed
Yellow / Okay: Pending 26-40% of allowed; aging 6-10% of allowed
Review (Needs Review): Pending 41-60% of allowed; aging 11-30% of allowed
Red (Needs Attention): Pending >60% of allowed OR >50 absolute (no truck data) OR any POs >90 days

What It Checks: PO creation and completion activity in lookback period; flags zero activity or many pending with no completions
Red (Needs Attention): No PO activity in period OR many pending with 0 completions

What It Checks: % of POs created in period that are received or exported
Multi-line PO rate (% of POs with >1 line); placeholder/generic description rate (% of lines)
% of invoices >$0 that have >=1 IsInventory material line
% of all invoice material lines that are IsInventory
Zero-cost IsInventory lines as % of all IsInventory lines (lower is better)
% of invoice material lines added by a technician
Replenishment completion rate (rate = 1 - open/completed); aging requests older than 30 days
Red (Needs Attention): Rate <50% OR open > 0 with 0 completed OR aging >20

What It Checks: Pending returns as % of total returns in period; returns older than 90 days
% of trucks with inventory templates (>=80%); warehouses with templates (>=1); templates with <20 active items
Red (Needs Attention): Trucks <80% with template OR warehouses <1 with template OR any template <20 active items

What It Checks: % of IsInventory materials with no invoice usage in lookback period
% of materials with $0 cost; % with Default or Imported Default Replenishment as primary vendor (purchasing-only)
Pending transfers older than 14 days (>20 = red); completed transfers vs expected (0.5x trucks x 1/week)
Past due inventory counts (>5 = red); negative balances (any = red); direct adjustments >20 in 90 days; warehouses with no completed count in 90 days
Green: All pass (<=5 past-due; 0 negative; <=20 direct adj; all warehouses counted)
Red (Needs Attention): Past-due >5 OR any negative balance OR direct adj >20 OR any warehouse uncounted in 90 days
